name: WordPress-Gatsby
desc: Web development technology stack with WordPress as a back end and Gatsby as a front end.

resources.name: WPGraphQL
resources.desc: Documentation - WPGraphQL brings the power of GraphQL to your WordPress site.

resources.name: WPGatsby
resources.desc: This plugin configures your WordPress site to be an optimized source for Gatsby.

resources.name: WPGraphQL Cors
resources.desc: This FREE plugin from @kidunot89 and @byfunkhaus claims to enable authentication with WPGraphQL to “just work” by allowing you to set CORS headers that GraphQL will accept, which means WordPress default auth cookies can be accepted.

resources.name: Total Counts for WPGraphQL
resources.desc: This FREE plugin from @builtbycactus exposes total counts to connections in the WPGraphQL Schema.

resources.name: WPGraphQL Gutenberg
resources.desc: Exposes Gutenberg blocks to the WPGraphQL API.

resources.name: WPGraphQL JWT Authentication
resources.desc: Extends the WPGraphQL plugin to provide authentication using JWT (JSON Web Tokens).

resources.name: WPGraphQL Lock
resources.desc: Enables query locking for WPGraphQL by implementing persisted GraphQL queries.

resources.name: WPGraphQL Meta
resources.desc: This FREE plugin from @robertorourke exposes meta registered via the WordPress register_meta API to WPGraphQL.

resources.name: WPGraphQL Meta Query
resources.desc: Adds Meta_Query support to the WPGraphQL Plugin for postObject query args.

resources.name: WPGraphQL Persisted Queries
resources.desc: This FREE plugin from @qz adds the ability to use Persisted Queries with WPGraphQL.

resources.name: WPGraphQL Offset Pagination
resources.desc: This FREE plugin from @enshrined adds basic offset pagination as opposed to the standard Cursor based pagination that ships with WPGraphQL.

resources.name: WPGraphQL Send Email
resources.desc: This FREE plugin from @Ash_Hitchcock allows you to send emails via a simple mutation. Includes the abilitty to restrict sending to trusted origins.

resources.name: QL Search
resources.desc: An extension that integrates SearchWP into WPGraphQL.

resources.name: WPGraphQL Content Blocks
resources.desc: This FREE plugin from the folks at QZ.com exposes a way to query HTML content from WordPress Posts and Pages as “Blocks” (not related to Gutenberg) to bring more structure to your queried content.

resources.name: WPGraphQL Enable All Post Types (DalkMania)
resources.desc: This FREE plugin from @DalkMania automatically adds ALL registered post types to the WPGraphQL Schema.

resources.name: WPGraphQL Enable All Post Types (TylerBarnes)
resources.desc: This FREE plugin from @tylbar automatically adds ALL registered post types to the WPGraphQL Schema.

resources.name: WPGraphQL Google Schema
resources.desc: This FREE plugin from @izzygld261 adds Google Schema support to WPGraphQL.

resources.name: WPGraphQL Gutenberg ACF
resources.desc: Exposes ACF blocks through GraphQL

resources.name: WPGraphQL MB (MetaBox)
resources.desc: This FREE plugin from @DalkMania adds all registered metaboxes using metabox.io to the WPGraphQL Schema.

resources.name: WPGraphQL MetaBox Relationships
resources.desc: This FREE plugin from @hsimah adds support for the metabox.io Relationships field to WPGraphQL (when also using his wp-graphql-metabox plugin).

resources.name: WPGraphQL Polls
resources.desc: This FREE plugin from @andrenosouza allows you to interact with data from the WP-Polls plugin via GraphQL Queries and Mutations.

resources.name: WPGraphQL Polylang Extension
resources.desc: Extends WPGraphQL schema with language data from the Polylang plugin.

resources.name: WPGraphQL Tax Query
resources.desc: Adds Tax_Query support to the WPGraphQL Plugin for postObject query args (WP_Query).

resources.name: WPGraphQL WPML
resources.desc: This FREE plugin from @rburgst extends the WPGraphQL schema with language data from the WPML plugin. In addition it turns off WPML default filters in order to be able to iterate over all posts regardless of language.

resources.name: WPGraphQL for Advanced Custom Fields
resources.desc: Exposes Advanced Custom Fields to the WPGraphQL Schema.

resources.name: WPGraphQL for BuddyPress
resources.desc: This FREE plugin from @RenatoNascAlves exposes BuddyPress data to WPGraphQL.

resources.name: WPGraphQL for Carbon Fields
resources.desc: This FREE plugin from @matepaiva exposes fields registered using Carbon Fields to the WPGraphQL Schema.

resources.name: WPGraphQL for Custom Post Type UI
resources.desc: This FREE plugin adds settings to Custom Post Type UI allowing you to set which Post Types and Taxonomies registered by CPTUI should display in the WPGraphQL Schema.

resources.name: WPGraphQL for FacetWP
resources.desc: This FREE plugin from @hsimah exposes filters on WPGraphQL queries to allow for faceted search with FacetWP.

resources.name: WPGraphQL for Gravity Forms
resources.desc: This FREE plugin from @KellenMace of @harness_up exposes @gravityforms data to WPGraphQL, allowing you to query for forms, fields, entries, and more.

resources.name: WPGraphQL for Metabox
resources.desc: This FREE plugin from @hsimah exposes fields registered using the popular http://MetaBox.io to the WPGraphQL Schema.

resources.name: WPGraphQL for Ninja Forms
resources.desc: This free plugin exposes forms created by the Ninja Forms plugin to the WPGraphQL Schema and allows for the forms to be submitted via GraphQL Mutations.

resources.name: WPGraphQL for Posts 2 Posts
resources.desc: This FREE plugin from @KellenMace of @harness_up automatically creates GraphQL connections for all of your Posts 2 Posts connections.

resources.name: WPGraphQL for SEOPress
resources.desc: This FREE plugin from @moon_meister exposes data managed by SEOPress to the WPGraphQL Schema, allowing for SEO data to be used in your headless applications.

resources.name: WPGraphQL for WooCommerce
resources.desc: This FREE plugin exposes WooCommerce data to WPGraphQL allowing you to interact with your store’s data via GraphQL Queries and mutations.

resources.name: WPGraphQl Yoast SEO Plugin
resources.desc: Exposes Yoast SEO data to the WPGraphQL Plugin.

resources.name: Advanced Custom Fields
resources.desc: ACF PRO

resources.name: Headless Mode
resources.desc: Headless mode sets up a redirect for all users trying to access the site. The only requests that are granted admission are ones that are either trying to access the REST API, the WP GraphQL API, or any logged-in user looking to access the headless install to edit or create posts.

resources.name: WP JAMstack Deployments
resources.desc: WordPress plugin for JAMstack deployments on Netlify (and other platforms).

resources.name: Gatsby Starter - WordPress Twenty Twenty
resources.desc: A port of the WordPress Twenty Twenty theme to Gatsby using the new gatsby-source-wordpress@v4.

resources.name: Gatsby + WPGraphQL Blog Example
resources.desc: Demo showing how to use WPGraphQL as the source for Gatsby Sites.

resources.name: Gatsby + Headless WordPress + Netlify Starter
resources.desc: A Gatsby + WordPress starter for continuous deployment to Netlify.

resources.name: Gatsby WordPress Starter Advanced
resources.desc: An advanced Gatsby + WordPress starter, that is built along a tutorial series and works with ACF flexible content fields to create content blocks/layouts.

resources.name: Gatsby Starter Blog
resources.desc: Blog starter with enough features to be production ready out of the box.

resources.name: Twenty Nineteen Gatsby Theme
resources.desc: A port of the Twenty Nineteen WordPress Theme over to Gatsby.
